title: Dry Patches on Face: Causes and a Gentle Routine That Helps
ex: Why rough, flaky patches appear on the face, a simple night and morning routine, what to do about winter peeling, and when to see a dermatologist.
rt: Dry Patches on Face: Causes and Simple Care | Mirc Glow
rd: Dry patches on face: common causes, a gentle routine for flaky skin, tips for skin peeling on face in winter, what to pause, and when to see a doctor.
quick: Dry patches on the face usually mean the skin barrier has lost water from harsh face wash, hot water, dry air or too many actives. Cleanse gently with lukewarm water, moisturise on damp skin twice a day and pause scrubs. See a dermatologist if patches are red, itchy or spreading.
facts: Hot water and foaming cleansers commonly dry out skin.
Moisturising on slightly damp skin helps hold water in.
Pause scrubs and strong actives until patches settle.
Red, scaly or spreading patches need a dermatologist's opinion.
